First you take a staycation. Yes, a staycation. They are even better than vacations because you actually relax. Second you buy what you think you need. If you are buying something for this, it is something you should probably have anyway. The next rule is to not depend on anyone else's labor for any benefit during that time (exceptions for being responsible may apply). During sudden war or disaster people don't go to work. Internet. Someone has to look at the traffic log to make sure nothing breaks done.
Heating. Look at electricity.
Gasoline. Someone has to drive the truck. Internet is needed to process payments.
